agents.name: triage-router
good_at: reading one inbound fault report and naming the single failing component plus the fault family in one turn
extracting the reproduction command and the first in-repo stack frame from a pasted traceback
deciding which of the declared downstream profiles should see the report next
agents.not_for: writing a patch, or deciding whether a patch is acceptable

agents.name: repro-extractor
good_at: turning a stack trace and a repro command into a minimal failing test invocation, offline
listing the files named in a traceback in the order they were entered
agents.not_for: anything needing network access or a metered call

agents.name: log-bulk-summarizer
good_at: summarising tens of thousands of log lines into a per-hour error histogram, tolerating minutes of latency
finding the first occurrence of a fault signature across a retained log window
agents.not_for: anything a caller is waiting on interactively

agents.name: dedup-checker
good_at: deciding whether an incoming fault signature matches an already-open incident, cheaply and locally
returning the open incident id when it matches and an explicit none when it does not
agents.not_for: judging severity or deciding whether to page anyone

agents.name: code-fixer
good_at: editing a repository until a named failing test passes, running the test command between edits
keeping a patch confined to the files a triage step named
agents.not_for: deciding whether the patch is good enough to ship, and any change outside the named files

agents.name: risk-escalator
good_at: writing the one-screen brief a human needs to approve or reject a patch: blast radius, rollback, what is unproven
naming the single fact that would change the recommendation if it turned out false
agents.not_for: making the decision itself, or editing code

agents.name: regression-test-author
good_at: writing one regression test that fails before a patch and passes after it, in the repository's existing test style
naming the test after the fault family so the next occurrence is searchable
agents.not_for: broad test-suite refactoring or coverage campaigns
